items.definition:
An administrative division in some Slavic countries.
The region is divided into several oblasts.

A program that analyzes text or code to determine its grammatical structure.
The compiler uses a parser to check the syntax of the code.

The outer part of a bird's wing; a small gear.
The bird's pinion was injured, preventing it from flying.

A part of the brainstem that links the medulla oblongata and the thalamus.
The pons plays a crucial role in sleep and respiration.

The use of an exaggerated outward show; a claim or assertion of a right.
His speech was full of intellectual pretension.

the process of returning to a former state or group
The program aims to support the reintegration of ex-offenders into society.

a group of assistants, supporters, or retainers accompanying an important person
The queen arrived with her full retinue of advisors and guards.

the formation of new and distinct species in the course of evolution
Geographic isolation can lead to allopatric speciation.

the endurance of pain or hardship without the display of feelings and without complaint
His stoicism in the face of adversity was truly admirable.

a soft, silvery-white metallic element
Strontium is used in fireworks to produce a bright red color.

a US federal government program designed to fund the cleanup of sites contaminated with hazardous substances
The EPA designated the abandoned factory as a Superfund site.

a mystical or esoteric text, especially one of a number of sacred Sanskrit treatises
She is studying ancient tantra texts to understand their philosophy.

the group of bones forming the ankle and upper part of the foot
He injured his tarsus while playing football.

a person, typically a man, who derives pleasure from dressing in clothes appropriate to the opposite sex
The play featured a character who was a transvestite.

a person who believes in universal principles or salvation
As a universalist, she advocated for human rights for all.

the study of viruses and viral diseases
She decided to specialize in virology during her postgraduate studies.

the state of being complete and undivided
She sought a sense of wholeness and balance in her life.

a medical doctor specializing in anesthesia
The anesthesiologist explained the procedure before the surgery.

secrets or mysteries
He delved into the arcana of ancient magic.

a scientist who studies the physical properties of celestial objects
The astrophysicist gave a lecture on black holes.

a system of government by one person with absolute power
The country transitioned from a democracy to an autocracy.

sexual relations between a person and an animal
The law prohibits acts of bestiality.

the quality of being central or important
The centrality of the issue made it a priority for discussion.

a word having the same linguistic derivation as another
The English word 'night' and the German word 'Nacht' are cognates.

the state of feeling remorseful and penitent
He expressed deep contrition for his actions.

the state or quality of being degenerate; decline or deterioration
The theory of degeneracy was popular in the late 19th century.

a reduction in the level of something, typically a financial asset or military force
The company experienced a significant drawdown in its stock value.

a type of battleship with an 'all big gun' armament
The dreadnought revolutionized naval warfare in the early 20th century.

the last remaining part of something; the sediment at the bottom of a liquid
He drank the last dregs of coffee from his cup.

a long, steep slope, especially one at the edge of a plateau or separating areas of land at different heights
The hikers carefully descended the steep escarpment.

evaluation; a function that evaluates an expression or string
The programmer used the eval function to execute the code dynamically.

an ancestor
Our forebears came to this country many generations ago.

a type of diving duck
We saw a goldeneye duck on the lake.

a terrifying or repulsive woman; a mythical monster
Medusa was one of the three Gorgons.

a drug made from cannabis
The police found a large quantity of hashish during the raid.

the study of blood
She decided to specialize in hematology after medical school.

a salt of hydrochloric acid
Many medications are available as a hydrochloride salt.

a person who favors intervention, especially in politics
The country's foreign policy was criticized by both isolationists and interventionists.

the state of being irrelevant
His arguments were dismissed due to their complete irrelevance to the topic.

a political philosophy that advocates for minimal state intervention in the free market and the private lives of citizens
Libertarianism emphasizes individual liberty and limited government.

a fine, strong cotton thread, typically mercerized
The socks were made of high-quality lisle.

a type of German semi-automatic pistol
The old soldier kept a Luger pistol as a souvenir.

a native or inhabitant of Madagascar, or the Malagasy language
The Malagasy people speak a language related to Malay.

a form of amateur dramatic entertainment, popular among the nobility in 16th- and 17th-century England, involving dancing and acting performed by masked players
The court enjoyed a grand masque performance.

a title of respect for a Muslim religious leader or scholar
Maulana Rumi was a 13th-century Persian poet.

amusement, especially as expressed in laughter
His jokes were met with much mirth from the audience.

an edible mushroom with a conical cap
We went foraging in the woods and found several delicious morel mushrooms.

a luminous cloud or a halo
A dark nimbus cloud gathered overhead, signaling an approaching storm.

the re-establishment of cordial relations
The two countries sought a rapprochement after years of tension.

the act of proving a statement or theory to be wrong or false
His detailed refutation of the argument was convincing.

a state of being pleasantly lost in one's thoughts; a daydream
She was lost in a reverie, staring out the window.

the act or process of slipping or falling
There was some slippage in the schedule due to unforeseen delays.

a small amount of something
He only has a smattering of French.

a person or animal that becomes separated from the group and falls behind
The last straggler finally crossed the finish line.

the coniferous forests of subarctic lands, especially Siberia and North America
The taiga biome is characterized by long, cold winters.

the remote diagnosis and treatment of patients by means of telecommunications technology
Telemedicine has become increasingly popular since the pandemic.

a slender threadlike appendage of a climbing plant, often growing in a spiral form, that stretches out and twines around any suitable support
The plant's tendrils wrapped around the fence.

a soft, fine, netlike fabric, used for making veils and dresses
The ballerina's skirt was made of delicate tulle.

the lowest social stratum in a country or community
The report highlighted the struggles of the underclass.

the past, especially a time remembered with nostalgia
The photographs brought back memories of yesteryear.

a person who speaks English
Canada has a large Anglophone population.

a thing or event that existed before or logically precedes another
The pronoun 'it' has 'the book' as its antecedent.

the act of bearing witness or giving testimony
The document requires an attestation from a notary public.

a traditional system of medicine with historical roots in the Indian subcontinent
Ayurveda emphasizes a holistic approach to health.
